conflict: {message} Your fields stay displayed here: copy what you want to keep before reloading.
titleHelp: In the menu and at the top of the tab.
homeAddressHelp: Home page: its address is the root of the site and cannot be changed.
keepOldHelp: Links that have already been shared ({links}) redirect to the new address. If unticked, they will show “not found”.
onlineHelpHome: The home page always stays live.
onlineHelpLive: Visible to everyone. Untick to take the page off the site.
onlineHelpOff: Not live yet: the page answers “not found” to your visitors.
inMenuHelp: At the end of the menu; change the order from the list of pages.
seoTitleHelp: Empty: the page title is used.
descriptionHelp: One or two sentences shown under the link in search results.
shareImageHelp: Shown when this page's link is shared. Empty: the first image of the page, otherwise your site's image (Settings).
contentCount: This page is made up of {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}.
contentIntro: {summary} The content is built in the visual editor: you add, move and delete blocks there, and adjust each one directly on the page.
blockProblem: A block is preventing saving: fix it in the editor.
editContent: Edit the content in the editor
noteDirty: The preview shows the saved version: save first.
noteLive: Page is live. “Save” only changes this information: the content is published with “Publish” in the editor.
noteDraft: Page not live yet: only visible in preview. It goes live with “Publish” in the editor.
savedRedirect: Saved · the old address redirects to the new one
savedBroken: Saved · old links to this page will stop working
savedNotLive: Information saved · page not live yet
